notes: «قال عبد أخبرنا وقال ابن رافع، حدثنا» is a change of verb only: one level of co-transmitters, one route to Abd al-Razzaq
«قال قال الزهري وحدثني حميد» is Zuhri speaking and then a second narration from Humayd: the route goes on through Humayd to Abu Hurayra
«بمعنى حديث هشام بن عروة» names a different transmitter for the same saying with no chain: a variant one-link group
